Hi Lydia — apologies for the brief delay, and thanks for the good questions. Answers below and attached materials.

Short answers (in-line):
1) EU residency: When you select "EU data residency" we run customer data and inference workloads in our EU data plane (region-specific GPU pools). The control plane (management/orchestration) remains in our control plane region for configuration, but the data path (inference requests, KV cache, model execution) is pinned to EU-hosted instances. In emergency fallback conditions we may route to the nearest compatible pool; however, for customers requiring strict residency we offer our Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) which eliminates cross-border runtime hops.

2) DPF/technical measures and logging: Attached is a short sequence diagram (redwood-routing-sequence.png) and the DPF assurance summary (Redwood_DPF_Assurance_Summary_2028.pdf). Key points:
- Requests are routed by a region policy evaluated at ingress; KV/prefix caches are colocated with model shards in the selected region; cached material is TTL-limited and encrypted at rest.
- Default logs capture metadata and anonymized telemetry (latency, errors). Token-level request/response content is not logged by default; PII redaction hooks are available and we can configure token-stripping for regulated controllers.
- KMS options: BYOK supported (customer-managed keys in their cloud project) or Redwood-managed HSM-backed keys. BYOK is recommended for enterprise Private deployments.

3) Contracting & SCCs: We provide a standard DPA annex with SCCs included and a supplementary technical measures exhibit. For hosted customers we will ask for a click-through DPA + order form; enterprise deals typically execute a master services agreement with the DPA annex attached. The attached DPA annex is suitable for immediate review and signature via DocuSign (link below).

4) On‑prem pricing (indicative): Private VPC deployment (multi-tenant private instance) starts at $75k/month committed for 3-year reserved capacity for steady throughput. Single-customer on‑prem appliance (hardware + installation + 12 months support) ballpark: $350k–$650k one-time depending on scale and integration. We can refine with more details about expected QPS and sequence lengths. Typical lead time for Private (VPC) is 6–8 weeks; full on‑prem is ~10–14 weeks.

Attachments included: Redwood_DPA_Annex_2028-08.pdf (DPA + SCCs), Redwood_DPF_Assurance_Summary_2028.pdf (detailed controls), redwood-routing-sequence.png (sequence diagram), subprocessor_list_2028-08.csv. Also included: SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf (operational evidence).

Next steps:
- Please review the DPA annex and return any redlines (or sign via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/Redwood/Hedgerow/DPA-Annex-4829).
- If useful, let's schedule a 30-min technical walkthrough with our Privacy/Engineering leads to walk the sequence diagram and BYOK options.

Regards,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
